_comment: INTERVIEWS & REVIEWS. Two shelves, deliberately unequal. `quotes` is small and loud — set enormous, one per screen. `clippings` is the ledger: everything else, scannable. Both arrays empty = the /press/ page still builds but drops out of the nav on its own.

quotes.text: I would recommend this book to fans of Terry Pratchett or David Lynch.

The best novel I've read in a while, satisfying to the end.
